title: BPW-2026-0576
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0576
CD 11
AFE – STATE WATER RESOURCES CONTROL BOARD
Bureau of Sanitation and Office of Accounting are requesting Board approval and execution of an Authority for Expenditure in the amount of $1,350,000 for encumbrance of funds to pay California State Water Resources Control Board annual permit and water discharge fees for the period of July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027.
(AE27760547M, Fund 760 - Sewer Operations & Maintenance Fund, Dept. 50, Appropriation Unit 50EX82)
summary: Asks the Board to approve $1,350,000 from sewer funds for State Water Resources Control Board annual permit and water discharge fees for July 2026 through June 2027.

details.action: authority for expenditure for permit fees
